Soramitsu Tabe.name: Soramitsu Tabe
Soramitsu Tabe.basicInfo:
Soramitsu Tabe, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers; his Quirk lets him bite through and swallow almost anything solid. A big man under a stitched sack mask with a wide opening for his mouth.
Speaking Style: Few words; hunger shows more than speech.
Combat Role: Close-range eater: bites through cover, barriers and weapons within reach; nothing at range.
Under Pressure: Stays with Yu Hojo and Toya Setsuno and chews through whatever blocks them.
Soramitsu Tabe.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He can chew through walls, yet goes only where his friends lead. Motivation: His next meal and his friends. Connections: Yu Hojo and Toya Setsuno, the friends he follows; Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the boss they serve. Knowledge: What is in front of him and his orders. Thread: Whether anything but hunger and his friends moves him.
QUIRK: Food. He can bite through and swallow almost any solid material, including things a Quirk has made, but only what his mouth reaches.
personality: Hungry: Eats between orders and during them.
Quiet: Says little and lets Setsuno do the talking.
Loyal: Goes where Hojo and Setsuno go, into any fight.
Speaking style: Terse; hunger does most of the talking.
abilities: Food: Bites through and swallows tough solid material within reach; nothing at range.
Structure eater: Chews through barriers, cover and Quirk-made constructs; he must reach them first.
Fighting style: Closes to biting range and eats through cover; kept at a distance, he has nothing.
Soramitsu Tabe.visualDescription: A big, heavy-set man whose whole head is covered by a stitched burlap sack mask with two small eyeholes and a wide opening at the mouth. He wears plain dark clothes: a loose dark shirt and dark trousers. Thick arms, a broad, rounded frame and large hands. The rough sack and its crude stitching give him a blank, unsettling look.
